notes: P6: the Browse grid (10e-spec). 6 columns @960 (cols = max(3, floor((width - 84 - 44 - 8 + 13) / 137))), GRID_GAP 13, poster cards.
nav browse:movie opens Movies/All with the first page; focus lands in the grid (row 0 col 0) once it has loaded.
'focus-r2c3' = row 2, column 3 (0-based): DOWN x2, RIGHT x3. The grid scrolls its FlatList so row 2 sits at the focus line.
The header count string depends on the fixture ('16 downloaded · N to stream'); it is deterministic on the private instance.
The skeleton state needs the instance started with --art-delay (the catalogue page itself is local, so skeletons only show for the art): kept out; blur-up is covered in card.json.

states.name: first-page
states.note: Movies / All, first page; header (h1, count, active), grid rows 0-2 visible, card 0 lit, the edge strip at the right

states.name: focus-r2c3
states.note: row 2 col 3 lit; the list scrolled two rows; the ring is on one card only

states.name: panel-open
states.note: RIGHT at the grid's right edge opens the filter panel (300 dp, 280 ms); 'All' chip on + lit (same frame as focusable chip-on-lit, listed here for the grid's own edge strip and dimming)
